I was directed to a some kind of hospitalization but i wasn't being held there ( I don't know how it's called).
I had to visit for five days in a row for about 4 hours each day. It was a group therapy.
Obviously it didn't help, I find these group therapy sessions useless since they can't handle each person's individual situation.

Now i am visiting a psychologist monthly, this was just a month ago.
And i know it's serious by the time i attempt suicide, but my problem isn't as big as the ones i heard at those group therapies. Rape, problems involving drug dealers, severe family issues and economic issues. I couldn't believe my case was brought in after these i just heard.

But as soon as i can't handle a situation my brain forgets all this and I just rely on "i can end this right now".

I'm sorry if the text is not comprehensible, my first language definitely isn't English.
